note: Settings the triage uses when no flag is given. They are first settings chosen for mstack, not measured values. Change them with the flags of triage.py.

repeat_min.unit: times one identical tool call (same name, same arguments) may appear before it is reported
repeat_min.source: mstack default, first setting; one retry of a failed call is normal, a third identical call rarely learns anything new
repeat_min.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

top.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number
